verdict.rationale: Datalab's convert API and SDK list "chunks" as an output format alongside Markdown, HTML, and JSON, so there is a first-party pre-chunked option rather than only a wall of text. The evidence never says how chunks are bounded, what metadata they carry, or whether they are sized for embedding. The schema-based segment endpoint only returns page ranges for logical sections, which is not RAG chunking. Missing for 10: documented semantic chunk boundaries, per-chunk metadata (headings, page, bbox), embedding-ready sizing or configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality.
